description.value: Hillkeep Regional Park is a nature reserve managed by the Fraser Valley Regional District on the outskirts of Chilliwack, offering natural landscapes typical of the lower Fraser Valley foothills. As one of several FVRD regional parks in the area, it provides a quiet escape into nature with designated trails. Touring cyclists exploring the Chilliwack region may find it a worthwhile side-trip destination, though the park's specific facilities remain unconfirmed from available sources.
